# name|fen|score_cp
# Scores are in centipawns from the side-to-move's perspective, produced by the
# tapered evaluation: material and piece-square tables read off the Board's
# running totals, plus pawn structure, king safety, rook placement and mobility,
# blended by game phase, plus a tempo bonus for whoever is to move.
#
# These are REGRESSION PINS, not judgements: the numbers are whatever the
# evaluation currently says, and they exist so that a change to it has to be a
# deliberate one. Retune a weight and these all move; that is the point. The
# relational tests in eval_test.cpp are where the chess claims live.
startpos|rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1|10
kiwipete|r3k2r/p1ppqpb1/bn2pnp1/3PN3/1p2P3/2N2Q1p/PPPBBPPP/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1|108
white-rook-king|8/8/8/8/8/8/8/R3K2R w - - 0 1|1103
# The same board with Black to move. The board-derived score negates exactly;
# the tempo bonus does not, so the two add up to twice the bonus rather than zero.
black-to-move-same|8/8/8/8/8/8/8/R3K2R b - - 0 1|-1083
# Bare kings and a lone bishop cannot mate: dead draws, scored exactly zero,
# tempo bonus included.
endgame-kings|8/8/8/3k4/8/8/3K4/8 w - - 0 1|0
insufficient-lone-bishop|4k3/8/8/8/8/8/8/4KB2 w - - 0 1|0
# Rook endgame: with the board nearly empty the taper leans on the endgame king
# table, which rewards White's centralised king and punishes Black's cornered one.
endgame-central-king|k7/8/8/8/3K4/8/8/7R w - - 0 1|669
# A pawn nothing can stop from queening, in an endgame where the passed-pawn
# bonus is at its full (doubled) strength.
passed-pawn-endgame|4k3/8/8/3P4/8/8/8/4K3 w - - 0 1|215
# Two pawns on one file: doubled once, both isolated because no friendly pawn
# stands on the b- or d-file to defend either of them, and only ONE passer
# between them—the rear pawn can never get past the one in front.
doubled-isolated-pawns|7k/8/8/8/8/2P5/2P5/7K w - - 0 1|225
# The same material and the same pawns, two corners for the king: behind f2/g2/h2
# it collects the pawn shield, on b1 it has abandoned it and the a/b/c files are
# wide open. The gap between these two entries is the king-safety term.
king-safety-sheltered|3qk3/8/8/8/3Q4/8/5PPP/6K1 w - - 0 1|448
king-safety-exposed|3qk3/8/8/8/3Q4/8/5PPP/1K6 w - - 0 1|423
# A rook with an open file in front of it, and the mobility that comes with it.
rook-open-file|4k3/8/8/8/8/8/1P6/R6K w - - 0 1|687
